exercises.instructionEn: Look at the short texts, then ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa matnlarga qarang, so'ng namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu yerda odam haqida 4 xil savol mashq qilinadi. Har biri boshqacha so'roq so'zi bilan boshlanadi:
• Where's ...? — qayerdan? (joy)
• How old is ...? — necha yoshda? (yosh)
• What's his/her job? — kasbi nima?
• What's his/her favourite sport? — sevimli sporti nima?
Javobda 'to be' fe'li qisqartiriladi: He's = He is.

example.speaker: S2
example.en: How old is he and what's his job?
example.uz: U necha yoshda va kasbi nima?

example.speaker: S3
example.en: He's forty and he's a musician.
example.uz: U qirq yoshda va u musiqachi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts. Copy and complete the table. Look at your notes and talk about each person, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni o'qing. Jadvalni to'ldiring. So'ng har bir odam haqida namunadagidek gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz: Jadval to'ldirilgach, undan foydalanib gap tuzasiz. Namuna: 'Fergus is from Edinburgh, Scotland. He's forty years old and he's a musician. His favourite sport is golf.' — ya'ni jadvaldagi 4 ta ustun 4 ta gapga aylanadi.
exercises.note: Carlos, Rosa, Veena qatorlari 6-betdagi matnlardan to'ldiriladi — o'sha sahifa qayta ishlanganda ulanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the cardinal numbers to the ordinal numbers, then listen and check. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Sanoq sonlarni tartib sonlarga moslang, so'ng eshitib tekshiring va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Sanoq son (cardinal) — nechta? one, two, three.
Tartib son (ordinal) — nechanchi? first, second, third.
Ko'pchiligiga -th qo'shiladi (four → fourth), lekin 3 tasi istisno:
• one → first
• two → second
• three → third
Diqqat qiling: five → fifth (ve tushadi), nine → ninth (e tushadi), twelve → twelfth.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the numbers, then listen and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Sonlarni raqam bilan yozing, so'ng eshitib takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
13 dan 19 gacha bo'lgan sonlar -teen bilan tugaydi. Ikki joyda yozilishi o'zgaradi:
• three → thirteen (thre emas)
• five → fifteen (fivteen emas)
Urg'u -TEEN da: thirTEEN. Bu 30 (THIRty) dan farq qiladi — urg'u boshida.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the missing numbers as words, then listen and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Yetishmayotgan sonlarni so'z bilan yozing, so'ng eshitib takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'nliklar -ty bilan tugaydi: twenty, thirty, forty...
Diqqat: forty da 'u' YO'Q (four → forty).
Aralash sonlar chiziqcha bilan yoziladi: 34 = thirty-four, 87 = eighty-seven.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with words from the list, then make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng namunadagidek gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Millat (nationality) va mamlakat (country) — boshqa-boshqa so'zlar:
• Brazil (mamlakat) → Brazilian (millat)
• Japan → Japanese
• Greece → Greek
• Spain → Spanish
Har ikkalasi ham katta harf bilan yoziladi.
Namuna gap: 'Paolo is Brazilian. He's from Brasilia, Brazil.'
